admin.title: Administration
admin.deleteSpellConfirm: Really delete the spell “{{name}}”? This cannot be undone.
admin.slugHint: Lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, e.g. fireball
admin.name: Name
admin.translationEmpty: Leave empty if there is no translation.
admin.unsaved: Unsaved changes will be lost. Leave anyway?
admin.exportText: Download all spells as a JSON file (format described in the README).
admin.importText: Choose a JSON file or paste its content. Accepted: an array of spells or an export object with a “spells” field.
admin.importDone: Import finished: {{created}} created, {{updated}} updated, {{skipped}} skipped, {{invalid}} invalid.
admin.deleteUserConfirm: Really delete the user “{{name}}”? Their spellbook will be lost.
admin.damageDiceHint: e.g. 8d6, 1d4+1, 2d8+1d6, 1d4+mod (spellcasting modifier). Leave empty if the spell deals no damage.
admin.spellbooksHint: Choose a user to view their spellbook.
admin.passwordSet: Password set. The user has been logged out on all devices.
admin.rolesHint: User: view spells and keep a personal spellbook (optionally with the extra permission “edit spells”) · Moderator: also manage and delete spells, manage stories and view all spellbooks and character sheets · Admin: also manage users, import and export. Permissions for info board and combat are set in Admin → Stories.
admin.charactersHint: All character sheets – read only. Only the owner can edit.
admin.charExportText: Download all character sheets of all users as a JSON file – including portraits and symbols. Useful as a backup or to move to another server.
admin.charImportText: Choose an export file. Each sheet is assigned back to its player by username. Existing characters are never overwritten.
admin.charInvalidFile: The file contains no character sheets.
admin.charPreviewSummary: {{total}} sheets: {{new}} new, {{duplicate}} already present, {{no_owner}} without matching player, {{invalid}} invalid
admin.charDuplicates: Same name for the same player
admin.userExportText: Download all users with email, role, language and “My Spellbook” as a JSON file – e.g. as a backup or to move to another server.
admin.userExportPasswords: Include passwords (encrypted) – users can then log in with their previous password after the import
admin.userExportWarning: The file contains the encrypted passwords. Keep it safe and do not share it.
admin.userImportText: Choose a user export file. Your own admin account is never changed by the import. Tip for moving servers: import spells first, then users, then character sheets.
admin.userPreviewSummary: {{total}} users: {{new}} new, {{exists}} existing (skip), {{update}} will be updated, {{no_password}} without password, {{conflict}} with conflict, {{invalid}} invalid
admin.userModeUpdate: update (email, role, language, password; spellbook is merged)
admin.userDefaultPassword: Initial password for users without password in the file
admin.userDefaultPasswordHint: Leave empty to skip such users. Users should change it after their first login.
admin.userImportDone: Import finished: {{created}} created, {{updated}} updated, {{skipped}} skipped, {{invalid}} invalid · {{favoritesLinked}} spellbook entries restored
admin.userFavoritesMissing: {{count}} spellbook entries refer to spells that do not exist here (yet) – import the spells first if needed.
admin.canEditSpellsHint: Create, edit and duplicate spells (not delete), without further rights
admin.canEditSpellsByRole: Admins and moderators can always edit spells
admin.boardExportText: Exports all stories with players, posts and comments (without trash). Authors are stored by username – so import users first.
admin.boardImportText: Stories with the same name are merged, otherwise created. Posts that already exist are skipped.
admin.boardInvalidFile: The file is not an info board export.
admin.boardImportDone: Import finished: {{storiesCreated}} stories created, {{storiesMerged}} merged, {{postsCreated}} posts imported, {{postsSkipped}} skipped.

board.heading: Info board

combat.hideStatsHint: Players then only see “unharmed / injured / badly wounded / defeated”. Can be toggled on the card at any time.
combat.playerModeHint: Player mode: see and play encounters like a user (only your stories' encounters, hidden monster stats, no management)

combat.noneAssigned: No sheets assigned to “{{story}}” yet (character sheet → Settings) – showing all.

bestiary.dmIntro: Your monster templates – shared by all Dungeon Masters and admins, invisible to players. Use them in combat via “Add monster” or “Add ally”.
bestiary.playerIntro: Shared monster notebook of your group “{{name}}”: all players can add and extend entries. The DM's data is not included here.

bestiary.unknownHint: Leave AC and HP empty if you don't know them (yet).

bestiary.dmOnlyHint: Only the DM sees attack and description.
bestiary.damageHint: Same as for spells, e.g. 1d6+2 or 2d8+4. Leave empty if no damage.
bestiary.hpRangeHint: HP as a number or range (e.g. 10-15) – leave empty if unknown.
bestiary.combatAttackHint: Shown on the monster in the combat tab (DM only) – e.g. its main attack with damage.

stats.crUnknown: Unknown challenge rating – allowed are 0, 1/8, 1/4, 1/2 and 1–30.

storyView.hint: In story view, character sheet, info board and combat lead directly to this story.

storyView.filteredCharacters: Story view “{{name}}” – only this story's sheets.

stories.title: Stories
stories.hint: Stories are created here and appear automatically on the info board and in combat. The role per story (player or Dungeon Master) decides what someone sees and may do there.
stories.membersHint: Players see the story's info board and encounters and write posts. Dungeon Masters run encounters, see hidden values, manage posts and read the story's character sheets. Without an entry the story is invisible (the admin has DM rights everywhere unless listed as a player).
stories.deleteText: “{{name}}” will be permanently deleted with all {{count}} posts, encounters and the players' monster database. Archive it instead to hide it.
stories.lifestylesHint: These values apply to all character sheets assigned to this story: the lifestyle is chosen on the sheet, the daily expenses come from here. New stories start with the Player's Handbook defaults.

lifestyleError.name: Every lifestyle needs a name.
lifestyleError.duplicate: Each lifestyle may only appear once.

stories.languagesHint: Choices for “Languages” on the character sheet (proficiencies & languages) for sheets of this story.
stories.toolsHint: Choices for “Tools & other” on the character sheet for sheets of this story.

items.hint: Create items per story and assign them to the players' character sheets (also several). Players are notified and see them on their sheet.
items.empty: No magic items in this story yet.
items.noStories: You don't manage any story yet. Magic items are managed by admin, moderators and a story's Dungeon Masters.
items.holdersHint: Character sheets assigned to this story (character sheet → Settings). Multiple selection possible.
items.noCharacters: No character sheets are assigned to this story yet.
items.deleteText: “{{name}}” will be deleted and removed from all character sheets.
items.sheetHint: This character's magic items – click a card for all details. There you can pass an item to another character of the story or return it to the DM.
items.sheetHintReadOnly: This character's magic items – click a card for all details.
items.sheetEmpty: This character has no magic items yet.
items.noTargets: No other characters in the story

items.attuneHint: You can attune to magic items your character owns that require attunement ("Magic items" tab).
items.attunementHint: Only items that require attunement can be chosen as attuned items on the character sheet.

catalog.title: Items
catalog.standardHint: Armor, weapons and gear for all character sheets without a story. Stories inherit this database and can adjust it under Admin → Stories → Edit story. Prefilled with the 5e basics (SRD).

catalog.deleteText: “{{name}}” will be deleted from the standard database – including all adjustments in stories.
catalog.deleteStoryText: “{{name}}” will be deleted from this story.
catalog.revertText: The adjustment of “{{name}}” in this story is discarded; the standard entry applies again.
